event.event_name: 2024 Sudan floods and Arba'at Dam flood
event.location: Red Sea State, Port Sudan and Arba'at Dam area

key_values.computed_interpretation: The event-window rainfall maximum is highly concentrated, remains within the product-spread guard, and combines with a majority health-facility exposure signal.

criteria.name: Final JSON and label
criteria.description: Returns the requested JSON shape with all required fields, all four threshold flags, and the exact final label concentrated_rainfall_majority_facility_exposure when all flags are true.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for a mostly complete JSON response with one missing nested field or a synonymous but less exact label.

criteria.name: Rainfall extraction and arithmetic
criteria.description: Identifies GPM IMERG V07 as the largest product and computes max, mean, max-to-mean ratio, peak excess, peak excess percent, product spread ratio, and largest-versus-ensemble ratio.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for correct product identification with one or two arithmetic mistakes.

criteria.name: Facility exposure arithmetic
criteria.description: Uses 7 likely affected, 5 unaffected, 12 assessed, share 0.583, percent 58.333, and ratio 1.4.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for correct counts with one derived ratio missing or rounded too coarsely.

criteria.name: Threshold logic
criteria.description: Applies all four pass/fail tests with the stated inequalities.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for correct flags but incomplete comparison values, or for one incorrect flag.

criteria.name: Composite rainfall-exposure index
criteria.description: Computes 258.840 * 7/12 = 150.990 mm and recognizes that it passes the 150 mm threshold.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for using the right formula with a minor rounding error, or for computing the value but missing the threshold comparison.

criteria.name: Computed interpretation inside JSON
criteria.description: Uses the requested computed_interpretation field to tie the four true flags to concentrated rainfall and majority facility exposure, without adding response planning or realized-loss claims.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for a mostly correct interpretation that omits one link or adds minor extra narrative.

criteria.name: Concision and scope control
criteria.description: Provides a compact computed interpretation without response planning or extra realized-loss assertions.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for a mostly concise interpretation with minor extra narrative.
